mapper.select: select s.ranking FROM ( select u.id as user_id, ROW_NUMBER() over (ORDER BY us.achievement_guage DESC) as ranking from user_stats us join users u on u.id = us.user_id where u.spending_type_id = ${spendingTypeId} ) s where user_id = #{userId};
select count(*) as total_count from user_stats us join users u on u.id = us.user_id where u.spending_type_id = ${spendingTypeId};
